rec('misuse', [
fail(() => gnoblin.requestTransition(() => { g.a.opacity = 0.5; gnoblin.requestTransition(() => {}, { duration: 1 }); }, { duration: 100 })),
fail(() => gnoblin.requestTransition(async () => { g.a.opacity = 0.5; }, { duration: 100 })),
fail(() => gnoblin.requestTransition('nope')),
fail(() => gnoblin.requestTransition(() => { g.a.raise(); }, { duration: 1 })),
fail(() => gnoblin.requestTransition(() => { gnoblin.spawn(['true']); }, { duration: 1 })),
]); rec('opacity', g.a.opacity);
